name: kotobase-client
description: Canonical kotobase datom-plane client (kotobase.client/cacao/cid) — portable .cljc consumed as a shadow-cljs source-path. NOTE: @noble/curves must stay on v1 (v2 removed secp256k1.utils.randomPrivateKey used by consumers).

scripts.test: amu compile --target wasm32-browser test && node out/node-tests.js
scripts.test:live: amu compile --target wasm32-browser live-e2e && node out/live-e2e.js
scripts.test:live-blocks: amu compile --target wasm32-browser live-blocks && node out/live-blocks.js
